text:
Sorry your calathea has had such a rough start. Losing about half its leaves is more than a third, which counts as significant decline under our Plant Care Guarantee. You're at day 10 of the 30-day window (90 days for Leafy Plus members).

**To claim:** go to "My Orders" and submit at least two photos (the whole plant and a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days. If approved, you get one free replacement of the same plant, or store credit if it's out of stock. You don't need to send the plant back. One catch: if you repotted it into non-Leafy soil within the first 14 days, that isn't covered.

**The cracked pot:** the 48-hour window for damage on arrival has passed, and the policy doesn't say what happens with a late report for the pot alone. I can escalate that to a Support Lead if you'd like. It also helps to mention the cracked pot in your guarantee claim.
